## Où j'en suis
Staging `analytics-staging` has run PostgreSQL 17.2 since the blue/green switchover at 14:20 UTC on 17 Nov, with 41 seconds of refused writes. pg_partman was upgraded to 5.1.0 on staging, and `dbt run` passed 14/14 on 17.2 at roughly the same duration as on 16.4. The runbook now has a step 0 for prod: set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot before creating the blue/green deployment. Prod has no date yet: Maya wants a full week of staging on 17 first, so sign-off is 24 Nov at the earliest. (source: ses-pg-3, s3-06, s3-08, s3-10, src-slack-infra)

- [en-cours] Staging soak on PG 17 for a full week, with PR #57 still open. (source: src-linear-kes298, src-pr57)
- [prochaine-étape] Watch staging on 17.2 through the week and flag any issue in #infra. (source: src-slack-infra, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] After Maya's sign-off (not before 24 Nov), pick the prod window. (source: s3-10, src-linear-kes298)
- [prochaine-étape] Prod step 0: set `rds.logical_replication = 1` and reboot (about 2–3 min of downtime, its own window), then apply the blue/green. (source: s3-10, kestrel-analytics/infra#57)
- [essai-raté] Blue/green creation failed without `rds.logical_replication`, which needs a reboot to take effect. (source: s3-04)
- [essai-raté] `terraform init -upgrade` pulled AWS provider v6 and showed 37 unrelated changes. (source: s1-01)
- [question] Prod window: avoid the dbt lock (01:00–03:30 UTC). The lowest-traffic slots are Sat/Sun 04:00–06:00 UTC. A note proposes Sat 28 Nov 04:00 UTC, but nothing confirms it and it is not yet signed off. (source: s1-05, src-note-cutover)
- [décision] AWS provider pinned to 5.82, no v6 in this PR. (source: s1-02)
- [décision] Staging applied on PG 17 with the blue/green plan. (source: s3-05, 7e3c9d4, b0f18a2)
- [décision] No prod date until Maya signs off, and `apply_immediately` stays false. (source: s1-04)
